name: sky
about: the sky all the way round, as it is now, over a pixel skyline: the sun by day, then the stars, constellations, planets and moon as it gets dark and the windows light up

licence.assets: stars.json is d3-celestial's star and constellation data by Olaf Frohn, BSD 3-Clause (d3-celestial-LICENSE.txt beside it). skyline-day, -dusk, -night and -windows.png are an AI-generated, Philadelphia-inspired pixel skyline made for this page from Anthony's reference photo: decoration, not a survey of the real horizon. Everything else is drawn in code
licence.notes: MIT. The sun, moon and planets are worked out on the kiosk (JPL's approximate planet elements); only the cloud forecast comes from Open-Meteo, and the page draws without it
